Yara (Docs): Heads-up  I'm going to add a short cross-language example set for Optimize: Rust + Python + Node showing micro-batching + kv prefetch + q4 profile. Goal: give infra teams a low-footprint Rust snippet that they can paste in internal ops playbooks.

Tom (Runtime): Interesting idea. We rarely ship Rust examples; make sure the snippet uses the HTTP REST API pattern (so it doesn't depend on an SDK package in CI). That will avoid ModuleNotFound in snippet-tests.

Elena (ML): Love it. For the q4 profile, add a micro-note about evaluation steps (100-prompt smoke test + spot-check 10 outputs) and call out that some model families show small tokenization edge regressions under q4.

Yara (Docs): Draft Rust snippet (HTTP POST):
```rust
use reqwest::blocking::Client;
use serde_json::json;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let client = Client::new();
    let body = json!({
        "model": "rwkv-7b",
        "prompt": "Summarize:",
        "max_tokens": 48,
        "micro_batch": 4,
        "kv_prefetch": true,
        "quant_profile": "q4_0"
    });
    let resp = client.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/generate")
        .bearer_auth("$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
        .json(&body)
        .send()?;
    println!("{}", resp.text()?);
    Ok(())
}
```

Sam (SDK): Nice. Since it's REST-based it should pass snippet-tests without SDK deps. One tiny suggestion: use `kv_prefetch` (snake_case) in HTTP body to match our server API, but call out SDK param mapping (micro_batch -> microBatch etc.) in the surrounding text.

Yara (Docs): Good call  I'll add a note: HTTP uses snake_case, language SDKs use camelCase per their conventions. Also adding short Node + Py SDK examples for parity.

Elena (ML): Please paste the YAML for q4 profile we recommend; I'll add the compatibility note recommending A100/T4 and an eval checklist.

Yara (Docs): YAML snippet: 
```yaml
name: q4_0
bits: 4
per_channel: true
compatible_ops: ['matmul','linear']
notes: 'Best on A100/T4; fall back to fp16/offload on unsupported devices'
```

Yara (Docs): Migration anchor: mapping table: `batch_size -> micro_batch` (HTTP/py snake_case), `prefetch_kv -> kv_prefetch`, `prefetch_cache -> kv_prefetch`. Include a safe git-backed codemod example: `git grep -l "batch_size" | xargs -I{} sh -c "perl -0777 -pe \"s/\bbatch_size\b/micro_batch/g\" {} > {}.new && mv {}.new {}"` and recommend reviewing backups.

Sam (SDK): CI heads-up: our snippet-test harness will flag the REST URL if it calls the production host. Use `https://api-staging.redwood.ai` or mock in the test harness. Add a note in the example block showing how to swap env var for TEST_API_URL.

Tom (Runtime): Also mention that micro_batch affects KV cache warmup behavior  shorter micro_batch tends to have more cache hits for interactive sessions, larger micro_batch helps throughput. That helps ops choose defaults.
